text:
olivia_cs: quick sync — Fennix renewal: they want to move from 12mo to 9mo and are asking for a 10% concession. procurement needs a PO with EU VAT details and wants the signer to be finance_ops@fennix rather than the original exec.

maria_sales: FYI i chatted with Aisha (Fennix AM). Primary risk is KMS onboarding — their security team won't sign a hosted key flow. they asked if we can add a KMS onboarding milestone to the SOW.

tyler_revops: 10% for 9mo is acceptable from revops if they commit to onboarding Dedicated within 60 days and sign the amended SOW. can we get legal to add conditional clause?

sam_legal: we can add a short rider: "signature conditional on KMS onboarding target (60 days) or fallback to escrow" — will draft. need exact wording from product about what "onboarded" means.

james_eng: onboarding means: Dedicated provisioned + KMS key material verified + OK from infra (we run a quick smoke). Estimate ~3 weeks if no infra blockers but could stretch if customer has on-prem HSM.

fennix_procurement: sending over PO draft now. note: billing needs split — EU entity pays EU invoices, US ops pays US portion. we put finance_ops@fennix as signer. can you confirm doc fields for delegated signer?

docbot: docbot: docusign envelope created (env_7721). placeholder signer role: "Finance Signer". reminder: if signer email differs from contract signee, set "Delegated Signer" checkbox.

olivia_cs: thanks. @sam_legal can you aim to share draft rider by EOD tomorrow? @james_eng can you confirm an onboarding checklist we can include as appendix?

sam_legal: yep — i'll draft and leave blanks for the checklist refs. will ask ops to provide checklist link.

james_eng: pushing checklist now. key items: 1) dedicated pool allocated, 2) KMS keys imported + test encrypt/decrypt, 3) smoke inference tests passing, 4) SSO and audit log hookup. i'll send a short bulleted appendix to drop into the rider.

maria_sales: also flagging enablement: their CS team wants a product walk + 2 training sessions for end users post-sign. can we bundle those in the SOW as two 60-min sessions within 30 days of provisioning?

tyler_revops: we can include two enablement sessions. Carlos (solutions) will run them. add as SOW deliverable.

fennix_procurement: PO attached: 
```
- Line 1: Redwood Inference Dedicated - 9mo commit - qty 1
- Price: $81,000 (after proposed 10% off)
- Billing split: EU entity 60% / US entity 40%
- Signer: finance_ops@fennix (Delegated Signer)
```
But procurement says they need the rider text before they sign.

sam_legal: understood. i'll drop a draft rider now and cc in this thread.

olivia_cs: great. action recap: sam -> draft rider by EOD tomorrow (owner). james -> appendix checklist + onboarding ETA (3w typical) today. maria -> confirm training dates with Carlos after rider posted. tyler -> approve final pricing, will sign off on 10% if rider + onboarding timeline in place. fennix_procurement -> hold on PO signature until rider present.

maria_sales: tagging Aisha to keep them in the loop: @Aisha (Fennix) — we'll ping as soon as rider ready.

fennix_procurement: noted. thanks team, will queue PO once rider and appendix are attached.

olivia_cs: we'll reconvene here once legal posts draft. :thumbsup:
